name: settings-change-read
description: The page writes the default log policy, which differs from the policy that the page wrote last; when the host notifies a change of the settings files, the listeners of the page that read the snapshot share one call of it: the page reads the snapshot once for the change, applies the changed value, and sends the theme and the menu language.
reason: The case delivers the workspace-changed notice of the host, and the Go producer runs no window and refuses a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
